snippet.title: The Light Brigade - Mixed Reality Trailer
snippet.description:
An award-winning roguelike VR shooter with realistic gunplay & immersive light magic. Ascend the ranks of The Light Brigade to unlock new weapons, upgrades, classes, and abilities as you fight to restore light to the darkness.

Mixed reality video created and edited by LIV.tv.

Play NOW!
🙏Play on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1579880/The_Light_Brigade/
🙏Play on Meta Quests: https://www.oculus.com/experiences/quest/2681027292004911/
🙏Play on PS5/PSVR2: https://www.playstation.com/en-us/games/the-light-brigade/
